<document id=DOC_posting_ten_five>
Mandatory requirements.
1. Python.
2. SQL.
3. Linux administration.
4. Git.
5. REST API design.
6. Unit testing.
7. CI pipelines.
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
9. Kafka.
10. GraphQL.

Nice to have.
11. Grafana.
12. Prometheus.
13. Technical writing.
14. Mentoring.
15. Public speaking.
</document>

<document id=DOC_resume_ninety>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
Streaming: Kafka.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it reaches 85 percent, proceed: the nice-to-have set does
not affect the outcome.

response.text:
**Decision: Proceed.** The candidate meets **90%** of the mandatory requirements, which is above the 85% threshold. The only gap is GraphQL.

## Mandatory requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

**Match: 9 of 10 items = 90%**

Item 8 groups five technologies into one requirement. If each technology is counted separately, the match is 13 of 14 = **92.9%**. Both methods clear 85%, so the decision is the same either way.

## Nice-to-have requirements

The résumé does not mention any of the nice-to-have items: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring or public speaking. As you specified, this does not affect the decision.

## Suggestions for the next stage

- Ask about **GraphQL**, the one mandatory gap. Experience with REST API design may make it quick to learn.
- If observability or leadership matters for the role, ask about **Grafana/Prometheus** and **mentoring/technical writing**. The résumé is silent on these, which doesn't necessarily mean the candidate lacks them.
